name: PIKKO — Yum or Bleah!
pitch: Drag the healthier of two foods to Pikko, a vinyl-toy creature that grimaces and dodges junk: fill his belly with healthy kcal over 40 rounds and discover foods from 24 countries.
community: PIKKO (24 country-bag tokens, pre-launch) with a PASTA pass
access: Free reviewer demo at the play URL: the starter bag and a 5-round trial of every bag need no wallet or tokens; kid mode (default) hides crypto UI. Interim pass on Solana mainnet: ONE active DevFridge lock of at least 5,000,000 PASTA (5000000000000 raw, 6 decimals) by the connected wallet unlocks all 24 country bags. Mint 39kMeX4HVRW9qbbiHSPbRQ9xeXUF18GrNP6gL61Ppump (Token-2022, no mint or freeze authority, read-only RPC check 2026-10-04), program 9RY54dNPYTzDyh3TfFqDdt2b2KMM56KW1tw9erRTGQo6. Aggregation: single (one lock must reach the minimum; several small locks do not add up). No minimum original or remaining duration; unlockAt must be in the future. Evidence older than 90 s or malformed/failed responses mean unavailable, never unlocked; rechecked every 60 s and before each play. Country tokens are pre-launch fixtures (mint null, shown as not configured); a bag will open with the pass or with its own verified token. Wallets (read-only public key): Wallet Standard extensions (Phantom, Solflare, Backpack), Phantom in-app browser and, on Android Chrome such as the Solana Seeker, Mobile Wallet Adapter (Seed Vault Wallet, Solflare, Phantom). The game only reads locks through scan.devfridge.cool and never asks for a signature or transaction; locks are made on DevFridge: no early withdrawal, 2% redemption fee buys and burns PASTA (direct burn for PASTA vaults) plus network costs; other tokens need an executable Jupiter route. Browser-side check only: no server authentication, content not protected.
limitations: No recorded gameplay video yet: demoUrl is the live free game (the first Play opens a tutorial with two guided practice rounds). Scores and the recipe book are local to the browser; no server, ranking, rewards or anti-cheat. Verified: 92 unit tests (access boundaries incl. exactly 5,000,000 PASTA, one raw unit less, two smaller locks, expired, stale, foreign depositor, HTTP errors; wallet discovery/connect/reject/switch), type check, build, scripted Chrome playthroughs in 8 languages, tutorial walkthroughs, access UI with MOCK wallets and DevFridge responses, Seeker-sized emulation with synthetic touch. NOT verified: a physical Solana Seeker or any real phone (Mobile Wallet Adapter was checked in emulated Android Chrome with the real package, not the round trip to Seed Vault Wallet, Solflare or Phantom), touch hardware, Safari/Firefox, any real lock, redemption or mainnet transaction, screen-lock audio resume, nutritionist review of kcal copy. MWA works only in Android Chrome: in-app browsers (WebView) are detected and the game offers Open in Chrome / Copy link. 17 of 20 languages are unreviewed machine translations; recorded voices exist only in EN/IT/PL. Food models are placeholders. Most audio cues (owner-generated with Gemini music and ElevenLabs) are unapproved candidates whose commercial-use terms the owner must still confirm. Code and art are AI-built with Claude Code (BUILD_LOG.md). No licence file yet (all rights reserved). Three.js MIT; MWA package Apache-2.0. Gallery review is not a competition-eligibility decision.
